policies.early_check_in: Subject to availability; free before 12 PM only if room is ready, otherwise 50% of one night's rate.
policies.late_check_out: Until 2:00 PM for a fee of $30, subject to availability.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Within 48 hours, the first night is charged. No-shows are charged in full.
policies.children: Children under 12 stay free when using existing bedding.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed, except service animals.
policies.smoking: All rooms are non-smoking. A designated smoking area is available outdoors.
policies.payment: Visa, Mastercard, Amex and UPI accepted. A card is required to guarantee the booking.

breakfast.details: Breakfast is not included in the room rate. A buffet breakfast is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for $15 per adult; children under 6 eat free. Rate plans with breakfast can be requested at booking.

amenities.name: Swimming pool
amenities.details: Outdoor infinity pool, open 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Towels provided. Children's shallow section available.

amenities.name: Spa
amenities.details: Full-service spa, open 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Advance booking recommended.

amenities.name: Restaurant
amenities.details: The Tide Room serves multi-cuisine lunch and dinner from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.details: Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property.

amenities.name: Airport shuttle
amenities.details: Available on request for $25 each way; please book 24 hours ahead.

faqs.a: Yes, an airport shuttle is available on request for $25 each way. Please book 24 hours ahead.
Yes, the lobby, restaurant, pool area and select rooms are wheelchair accessible.
Extra beds can be added to Deluxe King and Junior Suite rooms for $25 per night, subject to availability.
